blurb: The REEF is UCSB's teaching aquarium located at Campus Point Beach, part of the Marine Science Institute's Oceans-to-Classrooms education program. It features temperate and tropical aquaria and touch tanks ranging from 2 to 2,000 gallons. The REEF offers science communication aligned with Common Core and NGSS for K-12 students, teachers, college courses, and the community.
